descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S08 「现成的 spec：Generate 打开 Post-Round 并显示记录，重新加载后还在；生成失败时显示清楚的报错，并保留口述（两种模式）」 Existing specs: Generate opens Post-Round with the note, which survives a reload; a failed generation shows a clear error and keeps the dictation (both modes)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U10 Generate AI Note moves the physician to Post-Round with the generated note there.（UAT TC-14；TFA-92592 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT TC-14 step 5；UAT 3.3；TFA-92592 AC 14） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • T8 If both models fail, a clear error shows and the dictation is not lost (Empty & Failure States: 'Note not generated' shown, dictation kept; …（TFA-94422 AC 5；UAT Empty & Failure States；UAT OAT-03）
  • U4 Generation runs on the server: the physician can tap Generate and move to another patient; the Post-Round tab shows a 'generating' state, and on return the note is there or an explicit failure shows, …（UAT TC-14；UAT 3.5；TFA-92592 AC 15） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Tim's chromium specs: one with a mocked note (Hospital), two calling the configured model (Hospital and Nursing Home, each with a failure then a retry), and one where the first ai/notes:generateNote request fails at the socket (Hospital)

When Run the four specs by title

Then After Generate Note & Finish the 'AI-Generated Note' view is open with the generated text, the note and status are saved, and after a reload Post-Round still shows it, in both modes. When generation fails, an explicit message says the dictation is saved and the note could not be generated; the dictation stays in the box and in the database; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright verdicts. These run while the chart stays open; leaving the chart is S07 and S26. The failure half covers T8's 'clear error, dictation kept' with the build's wording ('…the formatted note couldn’t be generated and saved…'), not the UAT's 'Note not generated', so T8's wording half is reported with Q18, not as a silent accept (merged from S09)

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S08 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-14.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：测试问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92592 ready for pr；TFA-94422 ready for qa

医生那边没问题：老的 Playwright 用例还按旧流程点 Generate、再等任务，但 10-12 起按一次 Stop 就自动生成，SNF 的 fixture 又没有 pre-round 文本，所以两个用例都超时。

Nothing is wrong for the physician here. Tim's old Playwright specs still click Generate and then wait for tasks, but since 10-12 a single Stop generates the note automatically, and the SNF fixture has no pre-round text, so both specs time out.

依据：Allure 0f438342, verdict 测试过时（本地）. encounter-workflow.spec.ts:156: 7f3907f auto-generates on Stop (EncounterTab.tsx:84) and 726f724 stops deriving tasks after Generate. note-generation.spec.ts:248: the fixture has no rawPreRoundNotes, so 3878afa's stale guard keeps Generate disabled (red since 09-24). Bisected on an isolated stack: 5d83248 is not a regression.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：FAULT · 故障注入 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。

Failure screenshots and page snapshots are on the failing steps. Videos stay in matrix/TC-14-artifacts/ (not attached).
